review.use_summary: Calculated per-nucleus motif accessibility Z scores through Signac RunChromVAR with chromVAR1.16.0 after constructing motif annotations from human JASPAR2020 motifs. Correlated motif scores with mesenchymal-like scores using Pearson correlation and BH correction, then tested spatial autocorrelation with ape Moran.I and inverse-squared-distance weights.
review.implementation_scope_note: The validated native deviation/background methods accept explicitly prepared counts, annotations and bias/reference. They do not recreate the Signac/Seurat wrapper, JASPAR download, cell-state scoring or Moran.I analysis. Background settings, seed and the exact reference resources for this chromVAR call are unstated; do not infer them from defaults.

review.use_summary: Used chromVAR1.28.0 with the BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10 reference to calculate per-cell motif activity scores described as inferred transcription-factor activity from chromatin accessibility.
review.implementation_scope_note: The retained1.28.0 expectation, single/full deviation and background R functions match the validated functions; complete sampler C++ source is byte-identical. They are tested on recorded current dependencies, not a historical whole1.28.0 runtime. Motif collection, seed, background settings and a computeVariability call are not specified in this paragraph. Native indexed FASTA GC does not construct a BSgenome container.

review.use_summary: Reported per-cell chromVAR-style TF activity scores through ArchR addDeviationsMatrix after CisBP motif annotation with addMotifAnnotations and accessibility/GC-controlled background preparation with addBgdPeaks. Aggregated cells by type, location and inflammation and correlated integrated gene scores with TF activity; prioritized positive regulators and separately tested motif enrichment by a hypergeometric test.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is an ArchR workflow, not a reported direct R chromVAR call. ArchR backgrounds, matrices, aggregation and regulator filtering remain a separate implementation requirement; the chromVAR edition and seed are unstated. Preserve the reported correlation>0.4, intercluster deviation-z difference>0.25 and adjusted-P<0.01 criteria without treating them as chromVAR sampler options.

review.use_summary: Used chromVAR1.16.0 with cisBP motif sets from chromVARmotifs0.2.0. For main cell types, subsampled5000 cells and used Signac RunChromVAR, rescaled per-cell deviations to0–10, aggregated by type and correlated scaled motif activity with TF expression. For subclusters, retained peaks present in>20 cells and cells with>500 peak reads, resized peaks to500bp, scanned with motifmatchr1.16.0 and called computeDeviations before the reported rescaling/aggregation/correlation.
review.implementation_scope_note: The original paragraph explicitly reports ChromVar/v1.16.0 despite the initial extractor missing the edition. The native integration preserves raw deviation/Z scores; source subsampling, rescale0–10, aggregation, expression scaling/correlation, peak/cell filtering and exclusion of subclusters with<20 cells are separate operations. Do not confuse motifmatchr1.16.0 with the separately guarded scanner1.34.0 or claim a complete Signac/cisBP workflow.

review.use_summary: Computed per-cell motif activities with chromVAR, reported as1.5.0, within a multiome workflow that separately used Signac1.9.0 motif annotation/differential analysis and genomic visualization.
review.implementation_scope_note: The official upstream repository declares1.5.0. A retained reference commit available before publication has the same four core R functions; its sampler C++ differs from the validated source only by one missing final LF. The paper does not specify its commit, so the reference snapshot is not asserted to be its exact checkout or historical runtime. Signac AddMotifs/FindMarkers and CoveragePlot remain separate; do not silently relabel FindMarkers as FindMotifs. Cell Ranger remains excluded by user instruction.
